title: Final Heat Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The correct calculation of heat required at constant pressure must be provided.

title: Internal Energy Change
description: Essential Criteria: The increase in internal energy must be accurately calculated.

title: Work Done Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of external work done must be shown and correctly derived from Q and ΔU.

title: Constant Volume Heat
description: Essential Criteria: The heat required at constant volume must be calculated correctly.

title: Mole Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The conversion of grams to moles must be correctly performed using the molar mass of nitrogen.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units must be consistent and correctly used throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign mistakes in calculations must be avoided.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all necessary factors, such as specific heat and temperature change, are included in calculations.
